v1.56.2 (6 March 2025) |feed_title = Small Update |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.55.0]] |next_update = [[v1.57.0|The Hunt: Mega Edition Update]] }} ==Description== '''v1.56.0''' is the one-hundredth and seventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 26th of February 2025. It brought a few minor balancing changes to modes. This version contains three updates, the main v1.55.0 update (released 5 March 2025) and two minor updates, the v1.55.0a update (released 5 March 2025) and v1.56.2 (released 6 March 2025). ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Multiple game optimizations added. *[[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode base coins reward increased from {{Coins|200}} to {{Coins|250}}. *[[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode base coins reward increased from {{Coins|350}} to {{Coins|400}}. *[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode base coins reward increased from {{Coins|450}} to {{Coins|500}}. *[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode triumph bonus increased from {{Coins|50}} to {{Coins|100}}. *Removed all [[Operation I.C.E Event]] consumables from reward pools of the five survival modes. The only exception is the [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] from [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Pizza Party]] and [[Badlands II]] modes, and the [[Fruit Cake]] in [[Pizza Party]] and [[Badlands II]]. *[[Pizza Party]] changed. **Enemies now always give the same amount of cash on death, regardless of how much damage the player deals, but the amount is split between players, meaning in solo, an enemy gives 100% of its cash, 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. **Wave 39 wave bonus decreased from {{Money|75,000}} to {{Money|70,000}}. **Wave 35-38 now gives less cash through the wave bonus. *[[Polluted Wasteland II]] changed. **Wave structure changed. **Health scaling decreased. ***Trio health scaling decreased from 25% to 15%. ***Quad health scaling decreased from 40% to 30%. **Starting cash decreased from {{Money|1,150}} to {{Money|850}}. *[[Wastewalker]] health decreased from 50 to 40. *[[Wasterunner]] health decreased from 60 to 50. *[[Hazardous]] changed. **Health decreased from 200 to 100. **Defense of 50% added. *[[Super Mutant]] health decreased from 850 to 800. *[[Lurker]] health decreased from 300 to 250. *[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] health decreased from 2,500 to 1,500. *[[Mutagenic Blight]] changed. **Health increased from 4,250 to 10,000. **Speed decreased from Average (3) to Slightly Slow (2). **Defense increased from 30% to 50%. *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] health decreased from 1,800 to 1,500. *[[Super Slime]] health decreased from 15,000 to 10,000. *[[Nuclear Monster]] base health decreased from 750,000 to 625,000. :In '''v1.56.1''': *Fixed [[Pyromancer]] dealing no damage to enemies and targeting enemies incorrectly. :In '''v1.56.2''': *Version number changed from ''v1.56.1'' to ''v1.56.2''.
